name: Metis offline security sandbox
initializeCommand: set -e; mkdir -p output/runtime/sandbox-requests output/runtime/sandbox-artifacts output/runtime/security-sandbox output/runtime/sandbox-runner-diag output/runtime/sandbox-attest && chmod 1777 output/runtime/sandbox-requests output/runtime/sandbox-artifacts output/runtime/security-sandbox output/runtime/sandbox-runner-diag && (docker network inspect metis-sandbox >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker network create --internal --subnet 172.30.254.0/24 metis-sandbox) && docker network inspect metis-sandbox > output/runtime/sandbox-attest/network.json
postCreateCommand: python -c "import pytest, psycopg; print('Preinstalled test dependencies available; run tests via scripts/sandbox_test.sh (isolated runner)')"
